answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each identity to a refundable stake that vests slowly: a new agent deposits funds that unlock only after weeks of honest, verified work, so spinning up a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand deposits for weeks. Peers whisper reputation through signed attestations that flow like an ocean current - each attestation carries weight only from identities with real history - and a velvet-smooth market emerges where newcomers must earn trust gradually while attackers pay full price for every fake face.
